candidates.source_name: PISRS – Zbirka: Register pravnih aktov EU (Slovenian national transposition register)
candidates.why_relevant: Official national register mapping EU legal acts (title, CELEX, OJ reference, responsible Slovenian ministry/authority, validity dates, transposition deadline, Eurovoc descriptors) to the Slovenian instruments that transpose or implement them. This is the single best national transposition table for banking/payments directives (PSD2/PSD3, CRD, DORA, AMLD) and gives deadline data first-party.
candidates.legal_status: public government database (Uredba o Pravno-informacijskem sistemu RS)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of the EU-acts collection filtered by Eurovoc/domain terms; prefer the documented PISRS API over HTML scraping
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search for national transposition register
queries_used: PIS.si Pravno-informacijski sistem register predpisov Slovenije prenos direktiv EU

candidates.source_name: PISRS Developer API (swagger)
candidates.why_relevant: Documented programmatic access to the Slovenian legal information system, including regulations and (per PISRS structure) the EU-acts register — enables deterministic, low-friction long-term collection of transposition and consolidated-text metadata instead of scraping.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read swagger docs, then scheduled API pulls with change diffing
queries_used: PIS.si Pravno-informacijski sistem register predpisov Slovenije prenos direktiv EU

candidates.source_name: EUR-Lex – National transposition measures (NIM) collection
candidates.why_relevant: EU-side authoritative index of Member State measures notified as transposing a directive. For any banking/payments directive the 'National transposition' tab lists the Slovenian instruments (ZBan, ZPlaSSIED, ZPPDFT etc.) with notification dates, letting you detect late or partial transposition.
candidates.legal_status: public, reuse allowed under EU reuse policy
candidates.suggested_collection_method: CELEX-keyed fetch of the NIM tab per directive; EUR-Lex web services / SPARQL (Cellar) for bulk
queries_used: transposition table Slovenia PSD2 CRD national implementing measures EUR-Lex

candidates.source_name: EUR-Lex Slovenian-language (SL) act versions and legislative summaries
candidates.why_relevant: Official Slovenian-language texts and plain-language summaries of EU banking/payments acts (SEPA Regulation, PSD2, Instant Payments Regulation 2024/886). Provides the exact SL terminology used by Slovenian implementing law — essential as the translation layer for glossary building and for matching national texts to EU acts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: CELEX-based SL/EN parallel retrieval for terminology alignment
queries_used: EUR-Lex nacionalni ukrepi za prenos Slovenija direktiva plačilne storitve

candidates.source_name: N-Lex – gateway to Slovenian national law (with EU machine translation layer)
candidates.why_relevant: Commission-run single entry point into the Slovenian national database (PIS), with cross-country simultaneous search and automatic translation into other EU languages. Acts as the translation/aggregation layer for analysts without Slovene, and documents the structure and coverage of the Slovenian national collection.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as discovery/entry layer; collect from PISRS directly for stable identifiers
queries_used: N-Lex Slovenia national law database Uradni list RS arhiv iskalnik EU direktive

candidates.source_name: Uradni list Republike Slovenije (Official Gazette) – online archive
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative publication of record: every banking/payments statute and secondary act (ZBan-3/ZBan-4, ZPlaSSIED, Banka Slovenije sklepi) with exact publication date, which fixes entry-into-force and compliance deadlines. Its permanent archive is the primary defence against first-party pages being reorganised.
candidates.legal_status: official publication; text of law is public
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Issue-level polling of the table of contents plus keyword filter on banking/payments terms; stable SOP identifiers as keys
queries_used: eDemokracija predlogi predpisov javna obravnava arhiv zakon o bančništvu

candidates.source_name: e-Uprava / E-demokracija – Predlogi predpisov (public consultation register)
candidates.why_relevant: Central register of Slovenian draft regulations open to public consultation, with consultation closing dates. It is also the layer where withdrawn or superseded drafts (e.g. the Zakon o centralnem kreditnem registru draft) can still be located by id, making it the natural target for archival snapshotting.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate predlog-predpisa ids, snapshot each record and attached PDFs immediately (they disappear after the consultation closes)
queries_used: eDemokracija predlogi predpisov javna obravnava arhiv zakon o bančništvu

candidates.source_name: Državni zbor RS – Predlogi zakonov (bill tracker, EPA-numbered)
candidates.why_relevant: Parliamentary stage-by-stage tracker for banking/payments bills after consultation closes, keyed by EPA number, with readings, amendments and adoption dates. Complements PISRS by exposing the timeline between draft and Official Gazette publication.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll bill list; prefer the OPSI open-data mirror of 'Predlogi zakonov' for structured records
queries_used: Državni zbor zakonodajni postopek iskalnik aktov EPA arhiv predlogi zakonov banke

candidates.source_name: OPSI – Odprti podatki Slovenije (national open data portal), dataset 'Predlogi zakonov'
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable mirror of parliamentary bill data and, more broadly, the national open-data catalogue where government and supervisory datasets (registers, reporting outputs) are published under reuse licences — the lowest-friction structured entry point for archival collection.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: CKAN-style API harvest of dataset metadata and resource files
queries_used: Državni zbor zakonodajni postopek iskalnik aktov EPA arhiv predlogi zakonov banke

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Seznam predpisov / Regulation list (supervisory rulebook index)
candidates.why_relevant: The supervisor's own consolidated index of applicable regulations and its own sklepi/guidelines, thematically grouped (e.g. internal governance). Serves as the authoritative mapping from EU act to the Slovenian supervisory instrument implementing it, and as the crawl seed for archival snapshots of superseded versions.
candidates.access_status: open (exact path unverified; index is reachable from bsi.si financial-stability/regulation section)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the regulation section tree from https://www.bsi.si/sl and snapshot each act page plus PDFs; diff for version changes
queries_used: web.archive.org bsi.si arhiv javne obravnave sklep Banka Slovenije withdrawn

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Poročanje (reporting) hub and ITS supervisory reporting page
candidates.why_relevant: National reporting-taxonomy layer: publishes which EU implementing regulation governs supervisory reporting (Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/3117 replacing 2021/451), which forms apply, reporting levels, frequencies, reference dates and submission deadlines, plus national report types (SN-BST-KRD). This is the Slovenian expression of the EBA reporting framework and the direct source of reporting deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of the poročanje tree incl. FAQ pages and technical annexes; diff to detect new taxonomy versions and deadline changes
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language seed query on reporting taxonomy
queries_used: Banka Slovenije poročevalski okvir taksonomija nova različica rok poročanje

candidates.source_name: EBA Reporting frameworks / DPM taxonomy releases
candidates.why_relevant: Upstream authority for the reporting taxonomy that Banka Slovenije re-publishes. Framework 4.2 final technical package released 25 Nov 2025, applicable from Dec 2025, completing DPM 2.0; mandatory xBRL-CSV switch postponed to 31 Mar 2026; hotfix issued Jan 2026. Gives forward-looking deadline signals for Slovenian banks months ahead of national notices.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the reporting-frameworks page and press releases; capture technical package version numbers and applicability dates
candidates.discovered_via_method: English search snowballed from BSI reporting page
queries_used: EBA reporting frameworks DPM taxonomy release schedule reporting framework 4.2

candidates.source_name: EBA Interactive Single Rulebook
candidates.why_relevant: Consolidated view of CRR/CRD/PSD and their level-2/level-3 instruments article by article, letting you resolve which delegated/implementing acts and guidelines attach to any provision a Slovenian instrument transposes. Explicitly a documentation tool with no legal effect — always confirm against EUR-Lex.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Article-keyed lookups on demand rather than bulk crawl
queries_used: ESRB national policy measures database macroprudential Slovenia; EBA interactive single rulebook

candidates.source_name: ESRB – National policy / Macroprudential Measures Database
candidates.why_relevant: Cross-country database of current AND past national macroprudential measures notified under CRD V/CRR II — capital buffers (CCoB, CCyB, SRB, O-SII), borrower-based measures and reciprocation. For Slovenia it is the durable archive of measures whose original Banka Slovenije announcement pages get superseded, plus notification/application dates.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download the periodically republished overview file (PDF/XLSX) and diff releases for Slovenia rows
queries_used: ESRB national policy measures database macroprudential Slovenia; EBA interactive single rulebook

candidates.source_name: Single Market and Competitiveness Scoreboard – Transposition (Slovenia country pages, incl. archived editions)
candidates.why_relevant: Quantifies Slovenia's transposition deficit and outstanding directives against the 0.5% target, and links to infringement action for late/incorrect transposition. Useful leading indicator that a banking/payments directive is running late in Slovenia. The site retains an archive of older editions and per-Member-State PDFs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual/biannual pull of Slovenia country PDF plus the transposition dataset
queries_used: European Commission single market scoreboard transposition deficit Slovenia infringement database directives

candidates.source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine + CDX Server API (applied to Slovenian regulator domains)
candidates.why_relevant: The recovery layer for this cell: querying the CDX index for bsi.si, atvp.si, e-uprava.gov.si, gov.si/mf and uradni-list.si returns every captured URL with timestamp, MIME type, digest and HTTP status — which recovers withdrawn consultations, superseded sklepi and deleted deadline notices that first-party sites remove. Free, no authentication.
candidates.legal_status: public archive; respect rate limits and content rights of the archived originals
candidates.suggested_collection_method: CDX queries with url=<domain>/* &collapse=digest &output=json, then fetch selected snapshots; also push fresh Save Page Now captures of live consultation pages before their deadlines pass
queries_used: Wayback Machine CDX API archived Slovenian regulator website consultation ATVP azn.si arhiv

candidates.source_name: Tax-Fin-Lex – Register zakonodaje and 'Predpisi v pripravi' / Poročevalec DZ
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial Slovenian legal-tax aggregator with a full register of legislation, per-act timelines and all historical versions of amended laws, plus a 'regulations in preparation' collection tracking drafts through the parliamentary Poročevalec. Its version timeline is the fastest way to see how ZBan/ZPlaSSIED evolved with each EU directive.
candidates.access_status: partial paywall (subscription packages; some content and news free)
candidates.legal_status: commercial; ToS restrict systematic reuse — licence required for bulk collection
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/licensed use of the register and timeline; do not scrape. Use free news items as change signals only
queries_used: Tax-Fin-Lex IUS-INFO zbirka predpisi v pripravi register predpisov Slovenija naročnina
candidates.observed_blocker: Login/subscription required for full documents (login page returned for document detail URL)

candidates.source_name: Racunovodstvo.net – free consolidated texts of ZPlaSSIED and banking statutes (article-level)
candidates.why_relevant: Free, article-by-article republication of the Slovenian Payment Services, E-Money Issuance and Payment Systems Act (ZPlaSSIED) — the national transposition of PSD2. Useful as an accessible, linkable mirror and terminology source, but secondary: always confirm against PISRS/Uradni list.
candidates.legal_status: private site republishing public law; check ToS before bulk collection
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Light, occasional reference use; not a primary archive
queries_used: EUR-Lex nacionalni ukrepi za prenos Slovenija direktiva plačilne storitve

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Archive of former publications
candidates.why_relevant: The supervisor's own archive of discontinued publication series — the first place to look for superseded financial stability reports, supervisory statistics and reporting notices that no longer appear in the current publications navigation.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off deep crawl plus periodic re-check; mirror PDFs locally
candidates.discovered_via_method: search of supervisor site for archives
queries_used: web.archive.org bsi.si arhiv javne obravnave sklep Banka Slovenije withdrawn

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije statistical data warehouse (PxWeb 'Podatkovne serije')
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-queryable time-series database behind the central bank's statistical releases (financial markets, banking sector). PxWeb gives stable series identifiers and export formats, making it the statistical-release layer of this cell rather than a PDF-scraping problem.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: PxWeb API/CSV export per series with scheduled refresh
queries_used: Banka Slovenije poročevalski okvir taksonomija nova različica rok poročanje

candidates.source_name: European e-Justice Portal – National legislation: Slovenia
candidates.why_relevant: EU-maintained English-language description of the Slovenian legal-information architecture (PIS, its ~15 integrated databases, Uradni list as gazette of record, language coverage). Best onboarding map of which Slovenian database holds what, and a stable pointer when national portals are restructured.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read for source mapping; re-check annually
queries_used: N-Lex Slovenia national law database Uradni list RS arhiv iskalnik EU direktive

candidates.source_name: EU representation in Slovenia – transposition news (Predstavništvo EK v Sloveniji)
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenian-language Commission communications about transposition of EU legislation into national law, including infringement-package announcements naming Slovenia. A translation layer that surfaces EU enforcement pressure in the local language and vocabulary.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/news polling filtered on prenos zakonodaje, kršitev, opomin
queries_used: PIS.si Pravno-informacijski sistem register predpisov Slovenije prenos direktiv EU
local_language_terms_used: prenos zakonodaje EU v nacionalno zakonodajo

candidates.source_name: Third-party regulatory transposition trackers (ECSO NIS2 tracker, law-firm CSRD/NIS2 trackers)
candidates.why_relevant: Pattern-establishing example of privately maintained per-Member-State transposition trackers that state Slovenia's status and national instrument for a given directive, often faster than official notification. Relevant for banking-adjacent files (NIS2, DORA interplay, CSRD) where bank compliance deadlines are affected. Treat as a lead, verify against PISRS/EUR-Lex.
candidates.legal_status: third-party content; check reuse terms before republishing
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic snapshot of the Slovenia row; cross-check every claim against primary sources
queries_used: transposition table Slovenia PSD2 CRD national implementing measures EUR-Lex

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, publicly maintained Slovenia-specific transposition table for banking and payments directives (PSD2/PSD3, CRD, DORA) was found outside the generic PISRS EU-acts register and the EUR-Lex NIM tab. Neither Banka Slovenije nor the Ministry of Finance appears to publish a per-directive correlation table ('korelacijska tabela') publicly.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in sl and en; only generic registers surfaced. Correlation tables are typically attached to individual bill files (predlog zakona) rather than published as a standing dataset.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Directive-to-article mapping must be reconstructed from bill annexes on e-demokracija/DZ rather than pulled from a maintained table, raising collection cost and staleness risk.

negative_findings.description: Fetch of https://pisrs.si/zbirke/pravni-akti-EU returned only the page title with no body content — likely a JavaScript-rendered single-page application rather than a dead page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Content not extractable via plain HTTP-to-markdown fetch. Register field descriptions were confirmed only from search-result summaries, not from the live page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection from PISRS will need a headless browser or the documented PISRS API; a naive HTTP crawler will silently collect empty records.

negative_findings.description: No specific evidence was found of archived/withdrawn Banka Slovenije consultations or superseded supervisory deadline pages via general web search; search engines index the live site, not its Wayback snapshots.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search for archived bsi.si consultations returned only live pages. The recovery path is a direct CDX query against bsi.si, not a search engine.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Recovery of withdrawn drafts must be done by direct archive querying in the collection pipeline; the discovery phase cannot confirm what is recoverable.

negative_findings.description: Tax-Fin-Lex (and, by the same market pattern, IUS-INFO/Lex localis) place full consolidated texts, version timelines and 'predpisi v pripravi' behind subscription login.
negative_findings.result_summary: Document detail URLs redirect to a login page; only marketing pages and some news items are open.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The richest Slovenian regulatory-tracker layer is not lawfully collectable without a licence; the open substitute is PISRS + Uradni list, which lack the curated timeline view.

negative_findings.description: The acronym ATVP was pursued as the Slovenian securities market agency (Agencija za trg vrednostnih papirjev) but search results conflated it with an audiovisual media regulator, and no archived-consultation evidence was retrieved for it or for azn.si (Agencija za zavarovalni nadzor).
negative_findings.result_summary: No usable results; these non-banking supervisors were not confirmed as sources within this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cross-sector supervisors (securities, insurance) publish consultations relevant to payments/banking overlap; their archive layer remains uncovered.

coverage_gaps.description: Ministrstvo za finance (MF) regulatory pipeline pages and its own consultation/archive area were not directly located in this pass, although MF is the responsible authority for most banking/payments transposition recorded in PISRS.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted crawl of gov.si/drzavni-organi/ministrstva/ministrstvo-za-finance for 'javne obravnave', 'predlogi predpisov' and archived pages, plus CDX snapshots of those paths.

coverage_gaps.description: No Slovenian national web-archive layer was identified (e.g. a NUK/national library web archive) that might hold captures the Internet Archive missed for government and supervisory domains.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Investigate NUK (Narodna in univerzitetna knjižnica) web archiving programme and any legal-deposit web archive covering gov.si/bsi.si; assess access terms.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-specific reporting taxonomy (ECB payments statistics Regulation ECB/2020/59, SEPA/instant-payments reporting and Banka Slovenije's payment statistics reporting instructions) was not separately mapped; this pass covered prudential/ITS reporting only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on bsi.si payment-systems reporting instructions and ECB payments statistics releases, in sl and en.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact URL path for the Banka Slovenije 'seznam predpisov' regulation index is uncertain — it was inferred from a deeper child URL seen in results, not from the index page itself.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve the canonical index URL by crawling the bsi.si sl-language regulation section from the site root before wiring it into a collector.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian-language terminology for archival concepts specific to reporting taxonomies (e.g. 'taksonomija', 'tehnični paket', 'DPM različica') produced few national hits; Banka Slovenije largely re-uses EBA English terminology for taxonomy versions.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the taxonomy glossary bilingually, anchoring on EBA English version numbers and matching them to Slovenian 'ITS POR' / 'nadzorniško poročanje' pages.

brief: Slovenia's archive/aggregator layer is unusually well structured: PISRS's Register pravnih aktov EU is a genuine first-party transposition table (CELEX, responsible ministry, transposition deadline, implementing Slovenian regulation) with a documented API, and it is mirrored EU-side by the EUR-Lex national-transposition collection and N-Lex's translation gateway. Uradni list RS anchors dates of record, while e-demokracija and the Državni zbor bill tracker carry the pre-adoption consultation and deadline trail — the volatile layer that most needs proactive Wayback/CDX snapshotting, since withdrawn drafts and closed consultations vanish from the live portals. The reporting-taxonomy strand runs EBA (framework 4.2 / DPM 2.0, xBRL-CSV switch) down into Banka Slovenije's poročanje pages, which restate the applicable implementing regulation, forms, frequencies and submission deadlines nationally. The main constraints are a JavaScript-rendered PISRS requiring API or headless collection, a paywalled commercial tracker layer (Tax-Fin-Lex/IUS-INFO), and uncovered Ministry of Finance and payments-statistics reporting corners.
